City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
February 22, 2011
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificate of Appointment to Railroad Museum Foundation Boardmember John Ballard.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: February 7 (2)
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report recommending award of bid to Los Angeles Engineering Inc for PCH Water Main Replacement Project in the amount of $1,409,352 plus 15% contingency for a total of $1,620,755. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
e.
Report recommending installation of red curb between driveways at Mobil Gas Station at Narbonne Avenue and Pacific Coast Highway. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
f.
Report recommending change in posting for street sweeping on Lucille Avenue between Pacific Highway and 255th Street. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
g.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance 738, adding a new Chapter 9 of Title IV of the Lomita Municipal Code establishing administration and enforcement procedures pertaining to shopping cart containment and abandonment. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
h.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance 739, amending Ordinance 640 to correct the name of grantee for a pipeline franchise to Pacific Pipeline System, LLC. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
i.
Report recommending award of bid for design for Crenshaw/Lomita Blvd. intersection improvements to VA Consultants in the amount of $104,456 plus 15% contingency for a total of $120,125. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
j.
Report recommending lease of the city's unused water pumping rights. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
SCHEDULED MATTERS
6.
MUNICIPAL AREA EXPRESS (MAX) Discussion and possible action regarding participation in the Municipal Area Express.
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn in memory of Jane Hayton.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
